title: finding(plugin-kanban): two ObjectKanban.tsx docblocks assert in the PRESENT TENSE which face declares a key — three of the five keys they name are now declared, and this is the surface a changeset sentence gets copied FROM
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`, R1. ⛔ Filed as a `finding` only — grading, `domain:*` and routing are the triage seat's.

## The defect

`packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx` carries **two docblocks that assert, in the present tense, what the published schema faces declare** — and both are false against the tree they describe. This is objectui#9713's defect class, ⛔ in source comments rather than in a pending changeset.

Re-derived by this seat on `origin/main` `dea17b469`, ⛔ not inherited from the reporting round.

### Site 1 — `ObjectKanban.tsx:141` and `:145`

> 「… both **declared arms** of `ObjectKanbanComponentProps.schema` satisfy it and neither declares both keys — `KanbanSchema` declares `cardTitle` and tombstones `titleField` …, `ObjectKanbanSchema` declares `titleField` and **reaches `cardTitle` through `BaseSchema`'s index signature**.」

Two falsehoods:

- **「both declared arms」** — there has been **one** arm since objectui#8802 retired the bare `kanban` node key and its `KanbanSchema` arm.
- **「reaches `cardTitle` through `BaseSchema`'s index signature」** — `cardTitle` is **declared** on `ObjectKanbanSchema`, on both faces, since objectui#9606.

### Site 2 — `ObjectKanban.tsx:244-248`

> 「… the retired arm was the only declaration of `columns`, `cardTitle`, `swimlaneField` and `grouping`. Those four now resolve through `BaseSchema`'s `[key: string]: any` — **as `filter` always has** …」

Of the four named keys, **two are now declared** and the `filter` aside is false as well.

### The measurement, scoped to the schema rather than to the file

⚠️ A `grep` for these key names across `objectql.zod.ts` is the **wrong instrument** — the indentation is shared by every schema in the file, so it answers about the file and not about this schema. The block was extracted per symbol instead:

| key | `zod/objectql.zod.ts` | `objectql.ts` | the docblocks say |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | **`:2087`** declared | **`:3672`** declared | rides the index signature ⇒ **false** |
| `filter` | **`:2103`** declared | **`:3750`** declared | 「as `filter` always has」 ⇒ **false** |
| `cardTitle` | **`:2129`** declared | **`:3786`** declared | reached through the index signature ⇒ **false** |
| `swimlaneField` | absent | absent | rides the index signature ⇒ **true** |
| `grouping` | absent | absent | rides the index signature ⇒ **true** |

**[LIT CTRL]**, same instrument and corpus: `objectName` (`objectql.ts:3420`) and `groupBy` (`:3525`) resolve inside the same extracted block, so a key that IS declared is visible to it. **[ABSENT CTRL]**: a nonsense key reads **0** in the same block. The file itself reads 73 `objectui#` occurrences, so it is the file the addresses name.

⇒ the docblocks are **not uniformly wrong**: `swimlaneField` and `grouping` are still correct. ⭐ A blanket rewrite would replace one false sentence with another; each key needs its own verdict.

## ⭐ Why a source comment is worth a card when it publishes nothing

A source comment carries **no release deadline** — it does not publish verbatim, so nothing freezes it. That is exactly why this is easy to leave, and exactly why it should not be:

⚠️ **This docblock is the surface an author copies a changeset sentence FROM.** objectui#9704's carrier — a pending entry publishing a registry size that had been stale since before its own branch existed — was produced that way: a number was read off neighbouring prose rather than re-derived. A false docblock is a **factory** for the class objectui#9713 was filed about, sited one step upstream of it.

## Which repair this needs — ⛔ and it is not obvious

objectui#9713 establishes that a sentence falsified after it was written (**ROTTED**) and a sentence that was never true (**BORN FALSE**) need **opposite** repairs. For a source comment the calculus differs again from a changeset: ⛔ nothing here publishes, so preserving the retired reading has much weaker warrant, and the dated-reading construction that is right for a `.changeset/*.md` may be the wrong shape here.

⭐ **Taking this card means deciding that first**, in one line, before touching either site. The cheapest honest end state may well be to delete the claims rather than re-date them: `AGENTS.md` #9 says leave the count to the instrument, and a docblock that names which face declares a key is restating something `tsc` already answers.

## Dedup terms

`ObjectKanban.tsx docblock` · `cardTitle rides passthrough` · `retired arm was the only declaration` · `source-comment rot` · `objectui#9713 sibling`

## Provenance

Surfaced by the implementer of objectui#9713 (PR objectui#9723) while measuring that card's two pending entries, and correctly ⛔ **not** repaired there — that card scopes its repair to pending `.changeset/*.md`, and widening it into a plugin source file would have been the implementer choosing its own scope. Routed here; every address and both controls above were re-derived by this seat before filing.
